testimonials.title: A Rajputana Dream Lehenga
testimonials.body: “I wanted my bridal lehenga to tell our heritage story without feeling heavy. The Rajwadi Boutique team spent hours studying family heirloom motifs and recreated them in delicate Zardozi. It fit like a glove, and draping felt as light as a feather. I felt like a true Rajput princess!”

testimonials.title: Heritage Reimagined Abroad
testimonials.body: “Ordering my wedding wear from San Francisco seemed daunting, but Rajwadi made it incredibly smooth. They coordinated digital skin draping trials, custom color selections, and video consults. The ivory sherwani arrived perfectly fitted. They brought a piece of Jaipur home to me.”

testimonials.title: Modern Indo-Western Silhouette
testimonials.body: “I commissioned a custom floor-length gown in Firoza blue. The structural draping is an absolute work of art. The way the light catches the silk layers is stunning. I received endless compliments at the London reception. Truly unique, premium, and classy!”

testimonials.title: Exquisite Banarasi Tailoring
testimonials.body: “I sent my grandmother's vintage Banarasi saree to Rajwadi to be repurposed into a modern fusion cape suit. The craft preservation is outstanding. The gold borders were aligned precisely along the shoulders, and the fit is incredibly flattering. A masterclass in heritage styling.”

testimonials.title: The Royal Groom Sherwani
testimonials.body: “Being a groom, I wanted a simple but extremely premium look. The antique gold French knots on my raw silk sherwani were stunningly executed. The color theory consult was spot-on—matching the cream pigments directly with my skin tone. Outstanding craftsmanship.”

testimonials.title: Custom Gota Patti Saree
testimonials.body: “I commissioned a hand-dyed georgette saree in classic Rani Pink with heritage Gota Patti borders. The colors are so vibrant and alive. It drapes beautifully, and the border weight is distributed so evenly. Truly feels like wearing a piece of Jaipuri royal court history.”

testimonials.title: Flawless Fit via Video Calls
testimonials.body: “I was extremely skeptical about the remote measurements, but the video walkthrough made it dummy-proof. My silk anarkali arrived in Vancouver with a millimeter-perfect fit. The stitching is clean, with deep linings and premium piping. Will order again!”

testimonials.title: Matching Family Heritage Outfits
testimonials.body: “I was struggling to find premium ethnic wear for my 5-year-old and 8-year-old. Rajwadi custom-stitched miniature sherwanis and lehengas that perfectly matched our outfits. The fabrics were so soft on their skin, and they looked absolutely adorable. A lifesaver for family weddings!”

testimonials.title: Elegant Pastel Mehendi Wear
testimonials.body: “The sage green silk lehenga I ordered for my Mehendi was a dream. The hand embroidery has subtle pearls woven into the threadwork. The fabric is soft, breathable, and let me dance the night away without any discomfort. Highly recommend for luxury bridalwear!”

testimonials.title: The Ultimate Heritage Sherwani
testimonials.body: “We ordered both groom and bridal wear for our palace wedding in Udaipur. The aesthetic coordination was flawless. The royal fabrics, matching warm cream tones, and heavy Zardozi motifs complimented the palace lighting beautifully. Rajwadi is a true luxury experience!”

I had a wonderful experience with this boutique! The designs are extremely elegant and classy, and the handwork is absolutely beautiful. You can clearly see the attention to detail and craftsmanship in every piece. I am highly satisfied with the outfit I got stitched — it turned out even better than I expected. Truly amazing work. Highly recommended for anyone looking for sophisticated and beautifully crafted designs!
testimonials.title: Wonderful experience

testimonials.body: Great boutique! Nidhi was very helpful with her suggestions and design. The tailoring was also great and gave me the stitched garment on the scheduled time. Will definitely recommend this
